name: TMM deferred sell burn drains the TMM/USDT pair
summary: While freeTrade is off, every sell into the TMM/USDT pair adds twice the sold amount to waitBurnTokenAmount, and the next sell moves that amount from the pair to 0xdead and syncs. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker sold to grow the queue, bought the pair's TMM down to the queued amount, let a 1-TMM sell burn the rest and sold into the 1-wei TMM reserve.
notes: Fifth and last upgradeTo before the exploit activated the exploited TMM implementation; ownership was renounced right after, and no later state change was needed.

Loss is the pair's net USDT outflow (1,677,164.87) less 26,546.14 USDT the attacker took back by removing its own 1.9M LP in the same tx; that LP came from liquidity its EIP-7702 sybil wallets added days earlier (round trip, rule 11). USDT at DefiLlama $1.000136.
